newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia includes herders in social security.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia includes herders in social security.

text.p: Herders and private entrepreneurs became a part of Mongolia's new social security system on Saturday under a new law on pensions.
About 320,000 herders and 75,000 private entrepreneurs were included in social security funds, which the parliament has separated from the state budget.
Under the new law, both employers and workers will contribute to social security funds.
The law also raises the age for early retirement for women with four or more children to 50 from 38. The retirement age in Mongolia is 55 for women and 60 for men.

The new law tightens payment procedures, requiring interest to be added to late payments by banks and fines for officials who delay. In recent years many people have received their pensions up to four or five months late.
